intended_object: There is no mathematical object here. The definition picks a fresh variable, avoiding the free variables of an earlier auxiliary class term, as one step of an auto-generated nominal proof certificate. Its docstring says it is a "checked nominal proof certificate" called `nb059_alpha_dummy_025`.
explanation: The body is `freshVar (Class.cv (nb059AlphaDummy018 R S_cls)).fv 0`. It returns a variable that does not occur among the free variables of another auto-generated "dummy" term. The name says it is an alpha-renaming dummy, and the docstring calls it a proof certificate step. It is an implementation detail of how the library replays syntactic proofs: a bookkeeping device for alpha-conversion with no counterpart in the mathematical literature. So there is nothing to check it against.
